---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new signal, command, scaler rule or improvement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Area 🧭

- [ ] Signal (syscall, PSI, run queue, GPU, ...)
- [ ] Scaler (`croft scale`)
- [ ] Dataset or `croft profile`
- [ ] Deployment (Kubernetes, Helm, Docker, systemd)
- [ ] Other

## Problem

What is missing or hard to do today?

## Proposed Solution

Describe what you want to happen. Name the signal, option or output if you can.

## Alternatives

Other approaches you considered, such as what the HPA or KEDA already offer.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have checked this is not already requested in another issue
- [ ] The change fits croft's scope: autoscaling from what processes do in the kernel
